question: Can the 32-update language checkpoint process the full 131072-token ledger and return the early number on the measured Base request?
policy: Reuse the completed resident Base measurement on identical prompt IDs and exact greedy policy. Measure the development-qualified adapter at K2 with resident BF16 caches and the same 128-token prefill chunks. Stop at the first official turn boundary or EOS.
decision: Capacity requires consuming all 131072 prompt tokens and decoding at least one token. Retrieval independently requires an exact visible numeric answer at a completed first-turn boundary. Time both outcomes. One early key cannot qualify multi-document reasoning. A failed development checkpoint or absent completed Base baseline closes the measurement.
